mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the past month signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in labor market (PAYEMS) and housing sector (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and HOUST both above 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS and HOUST are both above 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for the tightening cycle regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% over the past month indicates weakening demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls > 5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly growth rate in employment (PAYEMS) below 0.5% signals a softening labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) each exceeding 1% over the past month signal broad demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 1% and RSAFS falls > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS fall > 1% in 1 month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
